blocks.text: Electronegativity kisi molecule mein atom ki woh taqat hai jis se woh shared (sanjha) electron pair ko apni taraf kheenchta hai. American chemist Linus Pauling ne electronegativity ka ek scale banaya jis ki qeematon ki koi unit nahi (dimensionless). Yeh qeematein alkali metals ke liye ek se thori kam se le kar fluorine ke liye zyada se zyada chaar (4) tak hain. Zyada electronegativity ka matlab hai electrons ke liye zyada kashish.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Linus Pauling duniya ka wahid shakhs hai jise do akele (kisi ke saath share na kiye) Nobel Prize mile: 1954 mein chemistry ka, chemical bond ki nature par kaam ke liye, aur 1962 mein aman (peace) ka, bare paimane par tabahi wale hathiyaron (weapons of mass destruction) ki mukhalifat ke liye.
Electronegativity par asar dalne wale factors

Bara atom ho to electronegativity kam hoti hai, kyun ke electrons nucleus se door hote hain aur kamzor kashish mehsoos karte hain. Maslan group 17 ke halogens ki electronegativity is tarteeb mein hai:

Effective nuclear charge zyada ho to electronegativity zyada hoti hai, kyun ke zyada nuclear charge bond wale electrons ko zyada kheenchta hai. Isi liye period mein baen se daen electronegativity barhti hai. Period 2 mein Li ki electronegativity 1.0 aur F ki 4.0 hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur aur chlorine mein kis ki electronegativity zyada hai, aur kyun? Aur chlorine aur bromine mein?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine ki sulfur se zyada hai: yeh usi period mein sulfur ke baad hai, is ka effective nuclear charge zyada aur atom chhota hai, is liye bond wale electrons ko zyada kheenchti hai. Chlorine bromine se bhi zyada hai, kyun ke bromine group mein neeche aur bara hai, us ke bond wale electrons nucleus se door hain.

items: Electronegativity: molecule mein atom ki shared electron pair ko kheenchne ki taqat; Pauling scale 1 se kam (alkali metals) se 4 (fluorine) tak.
Bare atom par kam (F > Cl > Br > I); zyada effective nuclear charge par zyada (period 2 mein Li 1.0 se F 4.0).
